title: M/s R.B. Edibells Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: B. Amit Sthalekar, J.; Manju Rani Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ petition dismissed; petitioner relegated to clause 6.5 remedy.
headnote: A writ seeking quashing of a recovery certificate for electricity bill arrears is not entertained where clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 gives a remedy before the Executive Engineer; the petition is dismissed.
facts: M/s R.B. Edibells Pvt. Ltd. filed a writ in the Allahabad High Court seeking quashing of a recovery certificate dated 26 October 2018 for Rs. 12,67,958 as arrears of electricity bills. The recovery was to be made from the petitioner, with the Executive Engineer, Electric Distribution Khand, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., Purvi Baipas, Chhibramau, District Kannauj, as a respondent. After hearing counsel for the petitioner, the licensee, and the Standing Counsel, the Division Bench considered whether the writ should be entertained.

holding_units.topic: recovery of electricity bill arrears — clause 6.5 remedy
holding_units.holding: A consumer challenging a recovery certificate for arrears of electricity bills has a statutory remedy of approaching the Executive Engineer under para 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the writ petition is dismissed on that ground.

principle_tags.application: Writ to quash a recovery certificate for electricity bill arrears was dismissed because para 6.5 of the Supply Code, 2005 supplies a remedy before the Executive Engineer.
The Court directed the consumer to the Executive Engineer, Electric Distribution Khand, DVVNL, Chhibramau, as the clause 6.5 forum for the billing-arrears recovery.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the recovery certificate dated 26.10.2018 and of the underlying electricity bill arrears of Rs. 12,67,958
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the bill or the recovery on merits.
